claims.name: UserManager
responsibilities: validates registration input and orchestrates user registration

claims.name: UserRegistry
responsibilities: registers and looks up users by delegating to PersistenceManager

claims.name: PersistenceManager
responsibilities: persists entities in a JPA transaction with rollback on failure

claims.name: UserFactory
responsibilities: creates User objects (Student or Librarian variants) from registration data

evidence.excerpt:
UserFactory factory = student ? new StudentFactory() : new LibrarianFactory();
        User newUser = factory.createUser(name, surname, email, password, identifier);
